content.text: {"subject":"Math","mode":"questions","extracted_questions":[{"question":"24 + 13 =","answer":"37","reasoning":"Add ones first (4+3=7), then tens (20+10=30), total 37 - check her written answer matches.","photo":0,"box":[180,350,650,400]},{"question":"45 − 18 =","answer":"27","reasoning":"Ask her to borrow from tens: 45-18, ones 5-8 needs borrowing so 15-8=7, tens 3-1=2, giving 27 - her sheet shows 33, ask her to recheck.","photo":0,"box":[180,480,650,535]},{"question":"56 + 27 =","answer":"83","reasoning":"Add ones 6+7=13, write 3 carry 1, tens 5+2+1=8, giving 83 - her sheet shows 73, ask her to redo with carrying.","photo":0,"box":[180,610,650,665]},{"question":"90 − 42 =","answer":"48","reasoning":"Ask her to subtract tens and ones carefully: 90-42, borrow from tens, 10-2=8, 8-4=4, giving 48 - matches her answer, good.","photo":0,"box":[180,740,650,795]}],"concept_explanation":null,"aditiApplicable":false,"aditiHook":null}
